scope: Autosave snapshots outside the project file and startup recovery selection
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12.0), docker --network none

desktop.note: Two of four runs at load average 33-35 were clean; the others failed only private-graph captures (pipewire-reference-control and similar), the known fixture flake; desktop-session passed every run

verified_behaviors: A helper process saves, edits, autosaves and aborts (CrashExit); the project file still holds the manual save
The crashed snapshot is listed with project path, time and track count; garbage and truncated snapshots are listed invalid with reasons and left in place
Restore brings back the crashed edits unsaved with the original project path; the project file is unchanged until Save; the restored snapshot is replaced by the session's own
Restore is refused over unsaved edits or for invalid snapshots; Discard removes only the listed file
A running session's snapshot (held lock) is not offered to another session; no autosave while clean; normal shutdown removes the snapshot
Actual pointer click on the banner's Restore button restores a second crashed session
limits: 30-second interval; edits made after the last snapshot are lost in a crash. Power loss, full disks and imported audio files themselves (referenced, not copied into snapshots) are not covered.
